a.text: Sir, are you saying such a remarkable individual actually existed in the history of Great Yan?
Cataloging books, organizing texts, promoting education... if she did so much for all life under Heaven, why does no one remember her, or even know her name?
Sir, can you identify this character? I don't believe I've ever encountered it before.
It's not that no one remembers her. It's simply that her 'true name in one lone word' was never recorded in the history books.
Isn't it a pity? Her pen captured Great Yan's long history and vast expanse, yet not a single page in the historical records bears her name.
Sir, if I were to complete all the missing records, do you think I could reconstruct her image?

steps.name: Hawking Shopworker
steps.text: Sir, sir!

steps.name: Hawking Shopworker
steps.text: It's raining so hard out there. Why not come inside, have a pot of nice, warm tea, and wait out the rain?

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: No need. This rain won't be stopping anytime soon—I should keep moving.

steps.name: Hawking Shopworker
steps.text: Haha. Some people want the rain to stop, some hope it carries on.

steps.name: Hawking Shopworker
steps.text: The umbrella vendor is smiling from ear to ear, but the passersby are downright miserable.

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: A fascinating thought...

steps.name: Hawking Shopworker
steps.text: Friend, you should take a moment to rest. I was asked to remind you: the road ahead is rough and uneven. A certain someone worries you might misstep, and get your shoes wet.

steps.name: Calm Man
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Hawking Shopworker
steps.text: Please just follow me, sir. Your friend is already waiting for you inside.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: High Minister... it's been a while.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: No... These days, you're... the Grand Tutor.
It has been some time indeed, since we bid each other farewell in Yumen.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I expected to meet with the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of War first upon this return to the capital to deliver my report.
That's why I've arranged to meet with you in advance.
His Imperial Majesty... has passed.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: When?
Two weeks ago.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I think... if His Majesty had died of natural causes, you would not be coming to see me about it.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Does this mean...?
The man sitting in the shadows holds out his hand. A black weiqi stone rests in his palm.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Sixty years ago, he escaped from that ancient temple and turned himself into one hundred eighty-one black weiqi stones, which scattered across the lands. Their current whereabouts are unknown.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Two weeks ago, the Sui Regulator found this stone in the capital.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: What... has he done?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I do not know.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The only thing I'm certain of is that he could not have entered the Forbidden City... someone must have gone out to meet him.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Investigating this person's identity would be... sensitive.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: His machinations likely will not involve others.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I shouldn't have come to you today, but when the convict caused all this turmoil before, you were the one who subdued him.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Grandmaster, do you know anything of this?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Not a thing...

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I have not seen him, since the incident.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Then I believe you, Grandmaster.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Do you need anything from me?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Do not linger here. Return to Yumen at once.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Ursus is in constant turmoil, and there is a changing of the guard in Yumen. We must not allow morale to be shaken.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I will handle the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of War myself. It is precisely because you are not entangled in this affair that I can entrust you with such a crucial task.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I will see the Sui Regulator continue to investigate the weiqi matter in secret.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: During this crucial time, you should remain out of sight, Grandmaster. We did not meet here today.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Regarding the True Lung... how is His Highness Yan Wu?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: At this moment, he should be—

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Yan Wu...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Yan Wu was the one who went to His Imperial Majesty... on the night he died.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Your Highness, twenty-eight members of the traitor's family have been imprisoned.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: But after we checked the list, we found there was a single individual missing—an infant just under a month old.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: The Imperial Guard searched the Grand Preceptor's mansion thoroughly today, but found no traces of the baby.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: A newborn could not have run off by herself.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: Someone went through the trouble to whisk her away.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Your Highness need not worry. The Imperial Guard will find her.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Earlier today, the Minister of Justice requested a meeting.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: He seeks His Highness's advice on this series of cases.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: Handle them... according to the Laws of Yan.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: I'll tell him.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: Where is my elder brother now?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: According to our reports, he left the capital just half an hour ago. Some of the Imperial Guard have defected with him.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: The soldiers guarding the city did not dare to stop them, without orders to do so.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: Indeed... I never ordered them to keep him in Baizao.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: He was unwilling to stay and left everyone behind.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: How many Imperial Guardsmen went with him?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Eighteen.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: Even after committing such an unforgivable crime, my elder brother can still send the Grand Preceptor to die in his place; he can still command the unwavering loyalty of these eighteen deathsworn.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: How many courtiers are still devoted to him? How many still hope that he will retake the throne?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Yet it is Your Highness who now sits on the throne, not him. Therefore, it falls upon Your Highness to ensure Yan's eternal prosperity.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: All castes of Yan may afford hesitation and uncertainty... save Your Highness.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: It's been so long since I've left this palace... Grand Commandant, tell me——

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: Has the spring rain yet ceased, in Baizao?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: The rain may stop whenever Your Highness desires.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: If Your Highness has changed your mind, you yet have time to stop them.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: ...I'm exhausted.

steps.name: Attendant
steps.text: The Imperial Kitchen has prepared some babao soup and shredded bamboo shoots. If Your Highness desires?

steps.name: Voice Behind the Curtain
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: There... there...

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: Don't cry. We're on our way home. We're almost there.

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Pick up the pace, please... if you could.

steps.name: Coachman
steps.text: It's raining too hard. And I can't see too well. Couldn't go any faster, at this rate...

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: How much farther to the next stage station?

steps.name: Coachman
steps.text: At least thirty li...

steps.name: Coachman
steps.text: Brother, just how urgent is your business... that you'd bring your whole family along to travel on a night like this?

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Please... just go faster.

steps.name: Coachman
steps.text: Ahhh! Ahhh!! What the——

steps.name: Coachman
steps.text: *Yanese exclamation* What's somebody doing out here in the wilderness at this hour?
The man looks around, but the endless rain blocks his view. It is too dark for him to see anything.

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: We'll have to get out here.

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Sir, I'll give you all the money I have. Take your carriage to the next stage station. If anyone asks, do not tell them you carried passengers with a baby tonight.

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: I beseech you, good sir.

steps.name: Coachman
steps.text: But.... what... huh?!

steps.name: Coachman
steps.text: Where are you going in this weather?

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: We'll follow the path through the northern woods.

steps.name: Panicked Woman
steps.text: Ahhhh!!!!!

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Panicked Woman
steps.text: The baby...

steps.name: Panicked Woman
steps.text: The baby is gone...

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: It's... it's her.
The baby is sleeping soundly in her cradle, oblivious to the mud and blood on her face.

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: I did everything you asked.

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: I know their methods, and I know how to answer them. Don't worry. I won't allow any blood to stain you.

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: Good sir, I have no way to repay your kindness.

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: No. You need not thank me. I did not do this for you.

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: She's done so much for me, yet what I do today will neither clear her name nor even begin to avenge her.

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: I have no family and no affairs to settle after my death. I ask only one favor of you.

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: Please, take this girl in.

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: You need not tell her anything. Just let her grow up and live her life in peace.

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: You know... if she stays here, it will be risky, with a greater possibility that this old case will be reopened.

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: But isn't that what you want?

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: We may be powerless to change the situation right now...

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: But if one day, be it three or four decades later, the truth is revealed...

steps.name: Man with Bloody Hands
steps.text: All the blood shall not have been shed in vain.

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: Right then. I swear it.
